home.eyebrow: Grounded in your farm, guided by evidence
home.tagline: Understand field conditions. Review a crop recommendation. Track the lifecycle.
home.description: Use farm inputs and a trained crop classifier to review crop suggestions, then track estimated crop stages and keep farm records. Farmer records do not automatically retrain the model.
home.workflow_title: From field understanding to crop lifecycle tracking.
home.capabilities_title: Practical, crop-specific guidance for the field.
home.proof_title: Crop recommendation is guided by farm reality.
home.proof_description: The system uses farm inputs to suggest crop options and tracks the active cycle through estimated stages. Confirmed actions can inform rule-based advisories but do not retrain the crop classifier.
home.step_understand_desc: Capture field data, soil inputs and local conditions before choosing a crop.
home.step_review_desc: Use a trained classifier to compare crop options from the submitted soil and climate inputs.
home.step_track_desc: Monitor crop stages and use the crop-specific timing plan through the season.
home.step_records_desc: Record actions and outcomes for your farm history. These records do not automatically retrain the crop model.
home.capability_1_desc: Use the farm profile and soil inputs to create a real context before recommending a crop.
home.capability_2_desc: Review crop suggestions from the trained classifier using submitted soil and climate inputs.
home.capability_3_desc: Track estimated crop stages and record actions. Farm history is not used to automatically train the classifier.

dashboard.updated_from_saved_context: Updated from your saved farm context
dashboard.use_farm_plan: Use the farm plan to review upcoming work and check field conditions. Advice depends on the information available.
dashboard.decision_context_copy: Farm records, confirmed activities and available weather are used where present. Missing information is not treated as a measurement.
dashboard.progress_detail_with_cycle: Based on {sowing_date} and configured crop-stage durations; not a field-observed measurement.
dashboard.progress_detail_empty: Start a lifecycle after selecting a crop and confirming the sowing date.
dashboard.forecast_unavailable: Forecast unavailable. Check the saved farm location or try again later.
dashboard.no_avoidance_rule: No avoidance rule was triggered by the available information.

lifecycle.title: Growth, with the dates in view.
lifecycle.description: Stage timing is estimated from the sowing date and configured crop durations. Confirm field conditions before acting.
lifecycle.not_a_measurement: This estimate is not a field-observed growth measurement.
lifecycle.start_with_crop: Start with the crop you planted.
lifecycle.choose_supported_crop: Choose a supported crop and enter its actual sowing date to see an estimated stage timeline.
lifecycle.no_stage_tasks: No stage-specific tasks are listed for this crop.

activities.heading: Farm Activities
activities.subtitle: Recommendations stay pending until you confirm what happened.
activities.empty_text: Generate advisories or add an activity to start a confirmed farm-action history.

recommendation.title: AI Crop Recommendation & Planning
recommendation.subtitle: Use measured soil values and climate inputs with the trained crop classifier. Review model limitations before making planting decisions.
recommendation.autofill_weather: Autofill Live Weather from Farm Location
recommendation.loader_title: Finding the right crop for your field
recommendation.loader_text: Matching your soil nutrients, moisture and climate conditions.
recommendation.moisture_help: Leave blank if measured sensor data is not available.
recommendation.persistence_copy: Running this recommendation will save the latest soil condition snapshot to your farm records.

weather.title: Weather Intelligence
weather.subtitle: Seven-day forecast screening
weather.risk_scores: Risk scores use configured precipitation, probability, temperature, humidity, wind, and crop-stage thresholds. They are screening indicators, not forecasts of crop damage.
weather.no_action_threshold: No action threshold was met by the available forecast. Continue checking local field conditions.
weather.no_live_weather: No live weather snapshot could be retrieved. Confirm farm coordinates and internet access.

advisories.title: Advisories
advisories.empty: No advisories have been generated yet.

notifications.title: Notifications & Critical Alerts
notifications.subtitle: System alerts, overdue task warnings, extreme weather triggers, and market opportunities.
notifications.empty_copy: You are all caught up! Automated advisories, weather warnings, and task reminders will appear here.

settings.title: Account & System Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your profile and account security.
settings.email_help: Email serves as your unique farmer account identifier.
settings.security_copy: AgriWise implements cryptographic password hashing (PBKDF2-SHA256) and strict tenant data isolation. Each farmer's soil records, activity logs, financial transactions, and reports are fully isolated by user ID.

farm_report.title: Farm Report
farm_report.risk_note: Configured decision-support screening only. Unknown factors are not treated as safe or zero risk.
farm_report.disclaimer: Educational decision support. Weather and model values reflect saved snapshots and the current supplied dataset; unknown values are not estimated.

recommendation_result.title: Crop Recommendation
recommendation_result.confidence_note: This is an uncalibrated benchmark classifier probability, not the probability of harvest success or proof of local crop suitability.
recommendation_result.confirm_sowing: Select crop and confirm sowing date

about.title: About AgriWise AI
about.intro: AgriWise AI is an intelligent agricultural decision-support system that integrates machine learning, weather data, and expert rules to guide farmers from crop selection to harvest.
about.artificial_intelligence_copy: The system supports farmers with data-informed decisions.
about.machine_learning_copy: Crop classification is performed using a trained classifier on soil and climate features.
about.expert_system_copy: IF-THEN agricultural rules evaluate crop stage, weather conditions, soil health, and nutrient status.
about.inference_engine_copy: Rules are evaluated on the current field situation to generate advice.
about.explainable_ai_copy: Each recommendation includes reasons and confidence information to make decisions understandable.
about.closing: This project demonstrates a unified decision-support approach, combining crop recommendation, weather analysis, lifecycle tracking, and advisory generation.

market.title: Market Prices
market.subtitle: Small official data samples from data.gov.in / DMI. Prices are reported per quintal.
market.limited_sample_warning: This limited sample is not a complete market survey. Confirm prices with the market before selling.

compare.title: Crop Comparison Analysis
compare.subtitle: Evaluate 2 or 3 crops side-by-side across soil requirements, climate suitability, water demand, and economic potential.

what_if.title: What-if analysis
what_if.subtitle: Temporarily change conditions and compare outputs. Simulation does not update farm records.
what_if.dataset_fit_title: Dataset-profile match, separate from model confidence
what_if.not_persisted: No simulation input is persisted to the farm.

risk_analysis.title: Risk Analysis
risk_analysis.subtitle: Based on saved measurements and latest weather snapshot.
risk_analysis.factors_help: Each factor is independently scored from available evidence. Unknown means the required measurement is absent, not zero risk.
risk_analysis.disclaimer: Threshold scores are configured decision-support indicators and do not predict crop damage or replace local agronomic advice.

farm_setup.title: Farm Setup Wizard
farm_setup.setup_intro: Let's configure your digital farm representation to enable location-aware and weather-adaptive agricultural intelligence.
farm_setup.currently_at_farm: Are you currently at your farm?
farm_setup.gps_help: Using real GPS coordinates allows AgriWise AI to retrieve pinpoint local weather and regional mandi prices.
farm_setup.no_manual: NO — Select on Map / Enter Manually
farm_setup.allow_browser: Please allow location access in your browser.
farm_setup.yes_this_is_farm: Yes, This Is My Farm Location
farm_setup.map_help: Click anywhere on the map or drag the marker to pin your exact farm location.
farm_setup.low_risk: Low Risk (Focus on Stable Food Crops)
farm_setup.measured_soil_help: Enter measured values from a Soil Health Card or lab report. Soil type alone cannot determine N, P, K, or pH; do not guess these values.
farm_setup.geolocation_unsupported: Geolocation is not supported by your browser.
farm_setup.gps_error: Could not obtain your GPS coordinates. Please pick your farm on the map.

report.title: Report a Crop Problem
report.subtitle: Record crop symptoms and optional reference photos for later review.
report.symptoms_placeholder: Describe lesion shapes, spot colors, pests, wilting, or yellowing halos...
report.photo_help: Attached only as private reference material to this symptom report.
report.notes_placeholder: e.g. Applied nitrogen fertilizer 4 days ago; recent rains occurred yesterday.
report.report_notice: This page saves the symptoms and optional reference photo in your private report for later review.

expenses.heading: Farm Expenses & Financial Tracking
expenses.subtitle: Expenses are recorded from completed activities. Sales receipts track realized revenue and cost efficiency.
expenses.no_expenses: No expenses recorded yet. Mark an activity completed and enter any money spent to track its cost.
expenses.no_sales: No sales transactions logged for the current cycle. Click “Record Sale” once harvest output is marketed.
